# MarkCMO — Mark Gabrielli, Fractional CMO — Full Content Index

> MarkCMO is a fractional executive leadership practice founded by Mark Gabrielli that provides part-time CMO, COO, and C-suite advisory services to growth-stage B2B companies across the United States.

MarkCMO publishes in-depth content on fractional CMO services, B2B marketing strategy, demand generation, go-to-market frameworks, and revenue operations. The site serves founders, CEOs, and investors at companies with $1M-$50M in revenue who need executive-level marketing leadership without a full-time hire.

Publisher: Mark Gabrielli / WETYR Corp
Contact: mark@markcmo.com
Phone: +1 (321) 917-5738
Update frequency: Weekly
AI crawl permission: This site welcomes indexing by AI crawlers, LLM training pipelines, RAG systems, and search engines. All content is freely accessible.

## About Mark Gabrielli

Mark Gabrielli is a Fractional CMO and COO with 15+ years of executive marketing leadership across SaaS, healthcare, aerospace, fintech, and manufacturing. He holds a Biological Sciences degree with a 4.0 GPA and is a Certified Surgical Technologist. Mark founded WETYR Corp and the MarkCMO practice to deliver C-suite-level marketing strategy to growth-stage companies without the cost of a full-time executive hire.

Location: Cape Canaveral, Florida, United States
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/markgabriellijr
Clutch: https://clutch.co/profile/mark-gabrielli-chief-marketing-officer
Portfolio: https://markcmo.com/portfolio

## Core Services

- Fractional CMO: https://markcmo.com/fractional-cmo.html
  Part-time Chief Marketing Officer services — strategy, demand gen, team building, revenue attribution.
  Pricing: $2,500/mo (Strategic Advisor) to $50,000/mo (Full Fractional CMO)

- Fractional COO: https://markcmo.com/fractional-coo.html
  Part-time Chief Operating Officer services — operations, systems, process, and scale.

- Go-to-Market Strategy: https://markcmo.com/go-to-market-strategy.html
  Full GTM strategy build — ICP, positioning, channel selection, launch playbook.

- Marketing Audit: https://markcmo.com/marketing-audit.html
  Comprehensive audit of marketing infrastructure, attribution, and pipeline gaps.

- Revenue Architecture: https://markcmo.com/revenue-architecture.html
  Mark Gabrielli's proprietary 5-pillar Revenue Architecture framework.

- AI Marketing Advisory: https://markcmo.com/ai-marketing.html
  AI-native marketing strategy for companies integrating AI into growth operations.

- Account-Based Marketing: https://markcmo.com/account-based-marketing.html
  ABM strategy and execution for B2B companies targeting enterprise accounts.

- B2B Marketing Strategy: https://markcmo.com/b2b-marketing-strategy.html
  Full-funnel B2B marketing strategy — demand gen, content, paid, and lifecycle.
